16.Sub-event_summary: Aerial surveillance insufficient; Cook instructed 4th Armored to sweep north bank between Tours and Blois with CCB from Lorient; patrols caused Germans to demolish bridges; XII Corps task force did same between Blois and Orléans; with bridges destroyed and surveillance, flank secure; Cook relinquished command due to health.
